text: Figure 7.1: Log mode As shown in the diagram, once the log mode is set to use the Logging back-end the configuration is of that back-end is centralized in the Machine manifest configu- ration. For example, the Logging back-end can be configured to store the logging information locally and that configuration would be kept in the Machine-specific man- ifest. Furthermore, the output channel on Ethernet for Log messages is configured with the PlatformModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration that is referenced byDltLogSink in the role endpointConfiguration. race
